Language detection APIs suggest geo-fencing to avoid CIS regions, but this remains speculative without runtime observation. Based on capa and YARA, the sample's primary capabilities are defense evasion via RC4 encryption (T1027) and system language discovery (T1614.001). The RC4 encryption likely protects a payload, while language detection may enable geo-fencing. No other capabilities such as persistence, privilege escalation, or data exfiltration were identified, though the import of ZwAdjustPrivilegesToken suggests potential privilege manipulation. {source: capa, query_or_table: 'capa Capability Rules', row_or_rule: 'encrypt data using RC4 via SystemFunction033, identify system language via API'}

The sample maps to two MITRE ATT&CK techniques: T1027 (Obfuscated Files or Information) for RC4 encryption, and T1614.001 (System Location Discovery) for language detection. These are inferred from capa rules, with MBC mappings C0027.009 (Encrypt Data) for T1027. {source: capa, query_or_table: 'capa Capability Rules', row_or_rule: 'ATT&CK column: T1027, T1614.001'}
